data.notes: As of the latest available confirmations, February 2027 has very few announced Tulum music events; Arena Festival is the only solid music-travel event crossing into the month.

events.title: Arena Festival 2027: 15th Anniversary
events.venueName: Playa del Carmen and Tulum, Riviera Maya
events.summary: Arena Festival’s 15th anniversary edition is confirmed for January 28–February 1, 2027 across Playa del Carmen and Tulum, with five days, eight parties, 30+ DJs, and a main party connected to Zamna Tulum. The official festival page notes Offer Nissim main party access within the pass while the full lineup is being revealed progressively.
